newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: ARCON reports positive results at Galmoy.
newsitem.headline: ARCON reports positive results at Galmoy.

text.p: Irish exploration group ARCON International Resources Plc on Wednesday it had achieved very positive results from its ongoing exploration programme in the Galmoy region.
The group said in a statement that it had highly encouraging drilling results in a new zone and further excellent drilling results at its lead-zinc mine at Galmoy in the Irish midlands.
ARCON said drilling had resulted in further mineralised intersections being encountered in the Templetouhy bog area, some six kilometres southwest of the mine.
"These early intersections already indicated an open ended resource in excess of 300,000 tonnes grading 12.16 percent zinc equivalent," ARCON said. It added that drilling continues in this area.
The company said that significant mineralised intersections continue to be encountered in areas surrounding the existing Galmoy orebodies.
The most recent set of results translate into an additional indicated resource of 314,000 tonnes grading 16.64 percent zinc equivalent, ARCON said. Drilling also continues in this area.

The group said its exploration programme is scheduled to continue with one drill rig fully deployed in the area of the Galmoy mine throughout the next year and another dedicated to the Templetuohy bog area and other targets which have been identified by geophysical exploration.
